About Northwind Analytics

Northwind Analytics is a data observability company in London. It was founded in June 2021 by Priya Raman and Tomas Eriksen, who had both spent several years running data platforms and were tired of learning about broken pipelines from the people who read the dashboards.

What we build

Northwind Analytics builds one product: a monitor that watches data pipeline freshness and latency from warehouse metadata, and alerts the team that owns the table. We are deliberately not a catalogue, a lineage tool or a BI product.

Where we are

Northwind Analytics Ltd is registered in England and Wales and works from 14 Fenchurch Avenue, London EC3M 5BN. You can reach the team on +44 20 7946 0102 or at hello@taxonomy-demo.test.
